title: fix: wizardDraftToAppSchema missing icon/label/branding fields
body:
Editing an app via the wizard and saving would silently drop `icon`, `label`, and `branding` fields from the persisted `AppSchema`, causing the app to vanish from the sidebar and app switcher.

### Root cause

`wizardDraftToAppSchema()` only mapped `title`, `logo`, `favicon`, `layout`, `navigation` — omitting `icon`, `label`, and `branding`. `EditAppPage` then overwrote the full app config with this incomplete schema.

### Changes

- **`packages/types/src/app.ts`** — Add `icon`, `label`, `branding`, `active` to `AppSchema` interface. Map `icon`, `label` (from `title`), and `branding` in `wizardDraftToAppSchema()`.
- **`apps/console/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx`** — Merge wizard output over original app config (`{ ...appToEdit, ...appSchema }`) so fields not managed by the wizard (e.g. `active`, `actions`, `areas`) are preserved.
- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/app-creation-types.test.ts`** — Add assertions for `icon`, `label`, `branding` round-tripping; add edge cases for missing icon and sidebar/app-switcher display.
- **`apps/console/src/__tests__/app-creation-integration.test.tsx`** — Add integration test verifying EditAppPage merge preserves original app fields (`active`) while including wizard-generated fields (`label`, `icon`, `branding`). Updated mock wizard `onComplete` to include `icon` matching real wizard behavior.

```ts
// Before
export function wizardDraftToAppSchema(draft: AppWizardDraft): AppSchema {
  return {
    type: 'app',
    name: draft.name,
    title: draft.title,
    // ❌ icon, label, branding all missing
    logo: draft.branding.logo,
    favicon: draft.branding.favicon,
    layout: draft.layout,
    navigation: draft.navigation,
  };
}

// After
export function wizardDraftToAppSchema(draft: AppWizardDraft): AppSchema {
  return {
    type: 'app',
    name: draft.name,
    title: draft.title,
    label: draft.title,
    icon: draft.icon,
    logo: draft.branding.logo,
    favicon: draft.branding.favicon,
    branding: draft.branding,
    layout: draft.layout,
    navigation: draft.navigation,
  };
}
```

### Testing

- ✅ 54 test files, 736 passed, 2 skipped
- ✅ 11 type tests covering `wizardDraftToAppSchema` field mapping and edge cases
- ✅ 14 console integration tests including merge preservation verification
- ✅ CodeQL security scan: 0 alerts

> <issue_description>### 现象
> 通过"应用向导"编辑应用并保存后，顶部导航和应用切换下拉菜单中部分应用消失（或名称/图标为空），无法切换到原来的应用。
> 
> ### 复现步骤
> 1. 进入应用，例如"应用A"
> 2. 点击"编辑应用"进入应用向导，做任意修改后保存
> 3. 返回顶部导航/应用切换
> 4. 发现当前或原有应用消失/名称为空/图标丢失
> 
> ### 期望结果
> - 编辑和保存后，顶部导航/应用切换下拉应正确显示所有应用，包括名称(label)、图标(icon)
> - 编辑保存不应导致已存在的 app 配置字段丢失
> 
> ### 问题分析
> - packages/types/src/app.ts 的 `wizardDraftToAppSchema` 只保存了 draft.title、logo、favicon 等字段，**未保存 icon/label/branding/active 等**
> - sidebar 工程中的 AppSidebar 依赖 app.label / app.icon 显示应用切换
> - 编辑/保存时，EditAppPage 直接用 wizardDraftToAppSchema 结果覆盖了原始 AppSchema，导致字段丢失
> - **实际保存后，后端返回数据缺少 label 和 icon，侧边栏就找不到应用条目**
> 
> ### 建议修复方案
> - 补全 wizardDraftToAppSchema 的字段：icon、label、branding、active
> - EditAppPage 保存时，和原始 app 配置做 merge 保留未在向导中维护的字段
> - 修复后确保 pnpm test、storybook、手动检查（已有测试可覆盖该场景）
> 
> ### 受影响文件
> - packages/types/src/app.ts
> - apps/console/src/pages/EditAppPage.tsx
> - apps/console/src/pages/CreateAppPage.tsx
> - apps/console/src/components/AppSidebar.tsx
>
